newsitem.title: USA: Staples, Office Depot extend merger pact to May 31.
newsitem.headline: Staples, Office Depot extend merger pact to May 31.

text.p: Staples Inc and Office Depot Inc said Friday they had agreed to extend their merger agreement to May 31. The pact had been scheduled to expire today.
The agreement is being extended to allow for the continuation of discussions with the Federal Trade Commission, they said.
Staples and Office Depot signed a definitive agreement to merge last September.

Staples operates 574 office products superstores in the U.S. and Canada. It recently agreed to acquire Kingfisher Plc's interests in Staples's two European joint ventures -- Staples UK and Maxi-Papier Germany.
Office Depot operates 572 stores in North America. It also operates joint ventures or licensed operations in Mexico, Israel, Poland, Thailand, France, Colombia and Japan.
